answer: Require each agent identity to be backed by a bonded stake locked for a long period, like a crystal vault that cannot be emptied overnight. A hollow identity with no stake, no completed work history, and no endorsements from established agents earns no voting or reward weight, no matter how many copies an attacker spins up. At dawn of each epoch, the network re-checks stake, history, and endorsements, so creating thousands of cheap clones costs real capital and time while yielding nothing.
